interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] Just [b]one coffee sachet[/b]. I have not slept.

response_choices: You do not look well, Binh.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] She changed the date in her book. My receipt says Friday. Her page says I borrowed it again on Saturday.
[color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] I am taking the receipt to her now. If I do not come back, do not let her say I left owing money.
